title: Is it possible to import sessions from MobaXterm?
author: learsw
body_snippet: Is it possible to import sessions from MobaXterm? If yes, how? Thanks

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Yes. **File → Import → Import from File**, then pick your MobaXterm sessions file. The file filter lists `*.moba`; if your MobaXterm export is `.mxtsessions`, either choose "All files" in the dialog or rename it to `.moba` — the content format is the same. mRemoteNG reads the `[Bookmarks]` sections and rebuilds the folder/session tree.

To get the file out of MobaXterm: right-click your sessions root → **Export sessions** (or copy the `[Bookmarks]` blocks from `MobaXterm.ini`).
